coder_result.remark: Comprehensive review of Workflow Builder v3 package. Found 2 MAJOR issues and 1 MINOR issue. MAJOR: (1) Standards/COMPOSITION_STANDARD.md missing from output package despite being one of three required output parts per spec Section 4.1, TC-GP-006. (2) promote_workflow_package action does not copy Standards/ or Specs/ despite spec Section 5.4 requiring it, TC-OW-020. MINOR: (3) step_completion step missing requires_human_approval_after field. All other checks pass: routing valid, all 22 artifact keys registered, 18 prompt files ASCII-only with bare placeholders, both actions implemented with proper error handling. Verdict: REJECTED -- v3 self-describing meta builder innovation is incomplete without Standards/ and Specs/ in the package.
